nodes.label: phoenix_lakehouse
nodes.description: Lakehouse core library providing contracts, definitions, Iceberg catalog config, GCS storage layout, and table contracts for the Proxima energy analytics platform

nodes.label: lakehouse_core
nodes.description: Python package exposing lakehouse config, catalog access, paths, and table identifiers as a clean API for consuming repos

nodes.label: lakehouse_core.config
nodes.description: Loads and validates lakehouse.yaml; exposes LakehouseConfig Pydantic model and get_lakehouse_config()

nodes.label: lakehouse_core.catalogs
nodes.description: Builds and returns a PyIceberg catalog client from config; exposes get_iceberg_catalog()

nodes.label: lakehouse_core.paths
nodes.description: Helper functions for building GCS paths: zone_prefix(), table_prefix(), get_full_gcs_path()

nodes.label: lakehouse_core.tables
nodes.description: Table identifiers, contracts, and utilities: get_table_identifier(), get_table_contract()

nodes.label: configs/lakehouse.yaml
nodes.description: Central YAML config defining GCS bucket, prefix, zones (raw/bronze/silver/gold), catalog settings, and table contracts

nodes.label: configs/tables/
nodes.description: Modular table contract definitions organized by domain; YAML files auto-merged by config loader

nodes.label: configs/tables/cenace.yaml
nodes.description: CENACE domain table contracts: bronze.pend (partitioned by market/region/zone/year) and bronze.pml (partitioned by market/region/node/year)

nodes.label: Raw Zone
nodes.description: Immutable storage of source JSON/XML files in GCS for replay and debugging; no Iceberg tables

nodes.label: Bronze Zone
nodes.description: Minimally structured Iceberg tables close to source; may include raw_payload column; first structured format (Parquet)

nodes.label: Silver Zone
nodes.description: Cleaned, normalized, typed Iceberg tables ready for analytics and joining; validated and deduplicated

nodes.label: Gold Zone
nodes.description: Feature/metrics/result Iceberg tables for modeling, dashboards, Monte Carlo outputs; business-ready aggregations

nodes.label: Apache Iceberg
nodes.description: Open table format used as the core abstraction for all structured data across bronze/silver/gold zones

nodes.label: Google Cloud Storage (GCS)
nodes.description: Single data lake storage layer; bucket novagrid-lakehouse is the canonical warehouse

nodes.label: pyiceberg[gcp]
nodes.description: Python library for Apache Iceberg with GCP support; runtime dependency >=0.10.0

nodes.label: pydantic
nodes.description: Data validation library used for LakehouseConfig model; runtime dependency >=2.0.0

nodes.label: PyYAML
nodes.description: YAML parser for loading lakehouse.yaml config; runtime dependency >=6.0

nodes.label: google-cloud-storage
nodes.description: GCS client library; runtime dependency >=2.10.0

nodes.label: google-auth
nodes.description: Google authentication library; runtime dependency >=2.23.0

nodes.label: Hadoop/File-based Catalog
nodes.description: Iceberg catalog type used: file-based on GCS, storing all metadata (snapshots, schemas, manifests) directly in GCS warehouse path; no external catalog service required

nodes.label: SQL Catalog (SQLite)
nodes.description: Alternative catalog configuration mentioned in docs: SQLite stores catalog metadata locally while GCS stores table data; portable and simple

nodes.label: data-pipeline
nodes.description: Prefect-based ETL repo that fetches raw CENACE data, persists to raw zone, writes to bronze Iceberg tables; primary consumer of phoenix_lakehouse

nodes.label: data-manager
nodes.description: Enrichment repo that reads bronze/silver tables, performs joins, writes to silver and gold Iceberg tables

nodes.label: revenue-models
nodes.description: Monte Carlo simulation and optimization repo; reads from gold tables, writes results back to gold zone

nodes.label: novafront
nodes.description: Full-stack revenue modeling UI; reference consumer aligned on novagrid-lakehouse bucket

nodes.label: novagrid
nodes.description: Revenue modeling engine; consumer of canonical lakehouse data from novagrid-lakehouse bucket

nodes.label: LakehouseConfig
nodes.description: Pydantic BaseModel with fields: bucket (str), prefix (str), zones (dict), catalog (dict), tables (dict)

nodes.label: get_lakehouse_config()
nodes.description: Returns validated LakehouseConfig singleton loaded from configs/lakehouse.yaml

nodes.label: get_iceberg_catalog()
nodes.description: Builds and returns a PyIceberg catalog client using config from get_lakehouse_config()

nodes.label: get_table_identifier()
nodes.description: Splits dotted table name into (namespace, table_name) tuple for PyIceberg catalog operations

nodes.label: get_table_contract()
nodes.description: Returns table contract dict (domain, zone, schema, partition_by) for a given table name

nodes.label: zone_prefix()
nodes.description: Returns GCS path prefix for a given zone name (e.g., 'bronze/')

nodes.label: table_prefix()
nodes.description: Returns GCS path prefix for a table including zone and domain (e.g., 'bronze/cenace/pend/')

nodes.label: get_full_gcs_path()
nodes.description: Returns fully qualified GCS URI for a table (e.g., 'gs://lakehouse_phoenix/bronze/cenace/pend/')

nodes.label: Table Contract
nodes.description: A YAML-defined specification for an Iceberg table: domain, zone, schema key, partition_by fields, and optional description; enforces naming conventions and standards

nodes.label: bronze.pend
nodes.description: CENACE PEND (zonal prices) bronze Iceberg table; partitioned by market, region, zone, year

nodes.label: bronze.pml
nodes.description: CENACE PML (nodal prices) bronze Iceberg table; partitioned by market, region, node, year

nodes.label: gs://novagrid-lakehouse
nodes.description: Canonical active lakehouse GCS bucket; single warehouse for all repos

nodes.label: gs://lakehouse_phoenix
nodes.description: Legacy/frozen parquet archive bucket; migration source, no new writes

nodes.label: gs://novogrid-workqueue
nodes.description: Frozen legacy bucket; no active writes, archived

nodes.label: cenace_workers
nodes.description: Canonical ingestion/backfill implementation in data_pipeline; writes bronze into novagrid-lakehouse

nodes.label: Parquet-to-Iceberg Migration
nodes.description: Process of migrating consolidated Parquet files from data_pipeline/data/ into Iceberg bronze tables in GCS; migration scripts live in data-pipeline repo

nodes.label: Storage as System of Record
nodes.description: Design principle: GCS + Iceberg is the system of record; compute engines (BigQuery, DuckDB, Spark) are disposable and interchangeable

nodes.label: No Hardcoded Paths
nodes.description: Design principle: no repo hardcodes GCS paths or schemas; all table definitions and layout live in lakehouse-core as the single source of truth

nodes.label: Pure Library Boundary
nodes.description: Design principle: phoenix_lakehouse is strictly a library providing contracts and definitions; no ETL, no Prefect, no API calls, no data writing; all operational logic belongs in consuming repos

nodes.label: Raw Data Preservation
nodes.description: Design principle: always keep a raw copy of source data (files and/or raw_payload) and treat bronze as minimally transformed; enables replay and debugging

nodes.label: Pinned Contract Authority
nodes.description: Design principle: consumers use phoenix_lakehouse through pinned versions (semver or date-based); upgrades are deliberate; worker snapshots are labeled artifacts with source revision metadata

nodes.label: Lakehouse Unification Plan
nodes.description: Strategic plan to unify all data paths around gs://novagrid-lakehouse as single canonical warehouse; freeze legacy buckets; standardize contract authority through pinned phoenix_lakehouse

nodes.label: BigQuery Not Used as Catalog
nodes.description: Explicit decision: BigQuery is not used as an Iceberg catalog in this repo; it may be used as a compute engine via BigLake/external tables in consuming repos; catalog uses file-based/SQL approach

nodes.label: Modular Table Contracts Pattern
nodes.description: Recommended approach: domain-specific YAML files in configs/tables/ rather than inline in lakehouse.yaml; scales better, clear git diffs, auto-merged by config loader

nodes.label: Naming Conventions
nodes.description: Standards: table names as {zone}.{table_name} in snake_case lowercase; domain names lowercase; schema keys as {table_name}_{zone}; partition keys must exist in schema

nodes.label: DuckDB
nodes.description: Optional local analytics engine for reading Iceberg/Parquet on GCS for quick modeling and exploration

nodes.label: BigQuery
nodes.description: Optional compute engine (not source of truth); accesses Iceberg tables via BigLake/external tables for ad-hoc SQL and dashboards

nodes.label: Prefect
nodes.description: Orchestration engine for running ETL flows; used in data-pipeline and data-manager repos, explicitly excluded from phoenix_lakehouse

hyperedges.label: Medallion Architecture (Raw/Bronze/Silver/Gold)
hyperedges.description: Four-zone data architecture pattern: raw (immutable source), bronze (minimal structure), silver (cleaned/normalized), gold (business-ready); defines the data maturity progression across the entire lakehouse

hyperedges.label: Lakehouse Consumer Ecosystem
hyperedges.description: Three external repos (data-pipeline, data-manager, revenue-models) all depend on phoenix_lakehouse as the single source of truth for contracts, paths, and catalog access; each handles a different stage of the data lifecycle

hyperedges.label: GCS Bucket Lifecycle (Active + Legacy)
hyperedges.description: Three GCS buckets in different lifecycle states: novagrid-lakehouse (canonical active), lakehouse_phoenix (frozen legacy archive), novogrid-workqueue (frozen legacy); unification plan governs migration from legacy to canonical
